Depends on collecting the items; the hand-ins take about 3 hours (includes 2 hours of waiting)

The addons of the {wiki:Warrior Outfits|Warrior Outfit}, the lighter version of the knight outfit. You get the first addon (spiked shoulder pads) from {npc:Trisha}, leader of the knights' guild in Carlin, and it is made by {npc:Cornelia}. The second addon (the sword) is forged by {npc:Morgan}, in Sabrehaven. With both addons you get the achievement Wild Warrior.
